description: This PHP class 'UpgraderCompleteController' is part of the OrangeHRM system, specifically within the installer upgrade process. It extends an abstract Vue controller and primarily manages the pre-render logic for the upgrade completion screen, setting up the Vue component and managing application state.
published: OrangeHRM ramework	he current class does not explicitly declare public symbols for outside usage besides its own methods, but it extends AbstractInstallerVueController which is likely to have some published methods.

classes.name: UpgraderCompleteController
classes.description: A controller class responsible for handling the completion step of an upgrade process in the OrangeHRM installer, configuring the Vue component and managing state as part of the pre-render phase.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Initializes the upgrade completion Vue component, sets its properties, updates the current screen in the state container, clears previous state, and logs an informational message about the system status.
